title: Shopping Cart
description: A shopping cart, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button, Card, NumberInput and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading, one line per item (its image, linked name, options and price, a NumberInput for the quantity and a Remove button) and an order summary Card with the subtotal and a Checkout button, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the image grows and each line's quantity moves beside it at @sm, the image grows again and the heading steps up at @md, and the summary moves beside the lines at @lg.
